label: Whatever has its being caused by something distinct from it is a creature
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise: whatever has its being caused by something distinct from it is a creature (DEF-CREATURE read as: ordered to a cause of its being). It counts a thing caused in being by a secondary cause as a creature too. SCOPE CONDITION (definition 80dea550, the same domain stipulation as 'Whatever has its being caused by another is not INFINITE_1'): elements of Being are individuated by their act of being, so the divine persons, one in numerically identical esse, are one element; the Son's being from the Father is no instance of CausesIn c x esse with c distinct from x. Read without this stipulation, with the processions as instances, the premise would make the Son a creature, contrary to the case's Nicene commitment.
